title: Coordinates of a test-form-integrable n-vector field are locally integrable
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let μ be a (Borel) measure on ℝ^P and let v : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) n: each v(x) is a continuous linear functional on n-covectors). Assume that for every test form ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n: smooth of every finite order, compact support, tsupport ω ⊆ U) the function x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable. Then for every compact K ⊆ U and every n-covector c ∈ Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (Covector (Eucl P) n), the function x ↦ v(x)(c) is μ-integrable on K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x)) μ) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ c : Covector (Eucl P) n, IntegrableOn (fun x => v x c) K μ
